item.title: Brigade Gateway
item.description: Brigade Gateway’s excellent sports facilities, including a large pool and multi-purpose hall, make it perfect for diverse learning sessions.

item.title: Prestige Lakeside Habitat
item.description: Prestige Lakeside Habitat was one of the first communities to adopt Unskooling. With an active RWA and a beautiful clubhouse, sessions here run every weekend.

item.title: Sobha Dream Acres
item.description: With one of the largest resident populations in East Bangalore, Sobha Dream Acres is gearing up to launch its first Unskooling sessions.
